name: Niv-Mizzet, Ghost Counsel
description: A dragon spirit who died against the nephilim and bought a seat on the Ghost Council, becoming its sole member.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet dies in battle against the nephilim.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet died in battle against the rampaging nephilim not long after Ravnica's decamillennial
